lessonRef.subject: financial-literacy
lessonRef.title: Launch and diagnostic: a product or service idea

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy Financial Literacy elementary sequence — Grade 4
Manuel Academy Financial Literacy G4 Unit 6 — simulated marketplace capstone
objective: Learners compare invented start-up costs across three pretend market ideas and test a production run against a fixed simulated budget.
scenario: Ismail is an invented fourth grader choosing between three pretend market ideas with invented start-up costs of $18.00 for a printed card set, $24.50 for a plant stand, and $11.25 for beeswax wraps. His simulated start-up budget is $50.00.
safetyNotes: Every amount, person, business, and account in this task is invented for practice. Nothing here refers to a real household.
Never write a real bank account, card, PIN, password, Social Security, or tax number on this sheet; the task never asks for one.
This is education, not individualized financial advice. Real money decisions belong to a trusted adult.

tasks.directions: Look across Ismail's three invented start-up costs.

prompts.text: What is the lowest start-up cost among Ismail's ideas?

tasks.directions: Find the spread between Ismail's dearest and cheapest ideas, then compare two of them head to head.

prompts.text: How much more is the dearest start-up than the cheapest?
Between the card set and the plant stand, which costs less to start?

tasks.directions: Ismail picks the beeswax wraps and wants to run 4 separate batches, each costing the same start-up amount in materials.

prompts.text: What do 4 batches of wraps cost?
How much of Ismail's $50.00 budget is left?

tasks.directions: The cheapest idea was not automatically the right one.

prompts.text: What would Ismail need to know about customers before the lowest start-up cost becomes the best choice?

remediation: If a learner treats the lowest cost as the answer, have them write next to each of Ismail's ideas who would buy it and why, before any comparison is made.
extension: Ask the learner how many plant stands Ismail could start inside the same $50.00 and what that means for his choice.
